result.topic_en: Evaluation of log k' and log 2K/π at rational points x = mπ/n and x = 2mπ/n (n odd), expressing the result through sums of Legendre symbols and fractional-part (sawtooth) functions.
result.transcription:
2) $x=\frac{m\pi}{n}$, $n$ ungerade.
$-\log k' = -\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0}\cdot\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\cdot q_0^{-n} + 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{2n}}\,\frac{\alpha^{ms}}{1-\alpha^{2ms}}$
$= A + 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n}^{t}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\cdot -\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\sum_{0,n-1}^{\sigma}\left(\frac{\sigma-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)\alpha^{ms(2\sigma+1)}\alpha^{-ts}$
1) $t\equiv m(2r+1)$ mod. $2n$
2) $t\equiv m(2r+1)+n$
$= A + 8\sum_{0,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)n - 8\sum\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)+n})\frac{1}{2n}\,n\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)$
$= A + 8\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+mn})-\log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+mn})\right)$
$-4\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+(m+1)n})-\log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+(m+1)n})\right)$
$= A + 8\pi i\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\left(\frac{2ms+(m+1)n}{2n}\right)-\left(\frac{2ms+mn}{2n}\right)\right)$
$= A + 4\pi i\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)(\cdots\cdots)$
$= A + 4\pi i\sum\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}\right)\left(\left(\frac{2s+(m+1)n}{2n}\right)-\left(\frac{2s+mn}{2n}\right)\right)$, $m\mu\equiv 1$ mod. $n$
$= A + 4\pi i(-1)^{m+1}\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}\right)$
$=(-1)^{m+1}\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0}+\pi i\left(\frac{n^2-1}{n}\mu - 4\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)\right)$

$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = 4\sum\frac{q^t}{t(1+q^t)} = \log\left(\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}\right)+4\sum\frac{1}{t}\left(\frac{q^t}{1+q^t}-\frac{1}{2}\frac{q^t}{q_0^t}\right)$
$=\log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}+2i\sum\frac{1}{t}\,\mathrm{tg}\,t\frac{x}{2}$,
1) $x=$ [-...-] $\frac{2m}{n}\pi$, $n$ ungerade.
$\alpha=e^{\frac{2\pi}{2n}i}$, $\frac{1}{1+r\alpha^{2\sigma m}}=\sum_{\sigma,n-1}\frac{(-1)^\sigma r^\sigma\alpha^{2s\sigma m}}{1+r^n}$
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi}=\log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}+2\sum\sum_{1,2n-1}^{s}\frac{1}{2nt+s}\,\frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1}$
$=\log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}+2\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n}^{t}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot -\frac{1}{2n}\cdot\alpha^{-ts}\sum_{1,n-1}^{\sigma}(-1)^\sigma\alpha^{2s\sigma m}$
$=\log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}+2\sum_{1,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm})(-1)^r\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\cdot n - 2\sum_{1,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm+n})(-1)^r\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\cdot n$
$= A+\frac{1}{2}\sum\left(\frac{rm}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)(-1)^r 2\pi i - \frac{1}{2}\sum\left(\frac{rm}{n}\right)(-1)^r 2\pi i$
$=\log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q}+2\pi i\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}^{s}\left(\left(s\frac{2m}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)-\left(s\frac{2m}{n}\right)\right)$

methods.what: Series/integral representation of -log k' at x = mπ/n (n odd) and its reduction via roots of unity to sums of logarithms
Evaluation of -log k' in terms of Legendre symbol sums and the greatest-integer function E
Substitution s -> μs with m μ ≡ 1 mod n in Legendre symbol sum
Lambert-type series for log 2K/π and its expression with tangent sum
Partial-fraction identity over n-th roots of unity
Evaluation of log 2K/π at x = 2mπ/n (n odd) via sawtooth/fractional-part sums
